name: 儿童卡通加绒防滑雨靴款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white studio #FFFFFF alternating with dreamy sky #DFF3FC panels and #29A8E0 section banners
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key, soft contact shadow; natural 5500K daylight in lifestyle scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless white studio sweep; outdoor lawn, shallows, leaves and snow in scene panels
styleLock.typography: rounded friendly geometric sans-serif, large playful headlines in dark charcoal #2D2D2D with short subtitle lines only, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: rounded-square numbered badges, thin circular ring infographic, wave-motif banner dividers
styleLock.presentationRules: pair shots centered at a slight 3/4 hero angle, stable scale across the set
noDrift: no cartoon character prints or branded graphics
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: cheerful kids rainwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, soft sky blue #DFF3FC and banner blue #29A8E0 with one coral-red accent #E64B3C for feature labels and dark charcoal #2D2D2D for text; cool bright tone; rounded friendly geometric sans-serif for large playful headlines and short subtitle lines only, no dense body text; clean white studio backgrounds alternating with dreamy sky-blue panels and blue section banners with wave dividers; bright soft high-key lighting with soft contact shadows, natural daylight for lifestyle scenes; consistent rounded-square numbered badges, thin circular ring infographics and wave-motif dividers; product centered and stable at a slight 3/4 hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cartoon character prints or branded graphics.

shots.intent: 微距材质与工艺标签收口，用可见的材质纹理与做工细节消除安全顾虑

shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF with light sky blue #DFF3FC rounded label chips
shots.textZone: rounded label chips on the left of each panel; one material line per panel

Two stacked macro panels: top panel extreme close-up macro of the glossy rubber upper surface with shallow depth of field; bottom panel macro of the rounded toe and heel base from a low 45-degree angle, the two panels filling 55-60% of the frame. Even soft high-key light with controlled highlights on the gloss, no harsh reflections. Pure white background #FFFFFF with light sky blue #DFF3FC rounded label chips. No props. Rounded #29A8E0 chips with text in #FFFFFF reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 on the left of each panel, and one short material line 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D per panel describing only what is visibly shown in the macro. 8K macro quality. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fake seals, no garbled text, no watermark, no cartoon character prints, no brand logos, no blurry subject.

provenance.notes: 源为童鞋详情页长图，按 9 片 790×1200 切片拼合分析。主产品据图为蓝底印花中筒儿童雨靴（橡胶/PVC 鞋身、绒里内胆、防滑纹大底、码数 23-36），归类 鞋靴/童鞋，leaf=儿童卡通印花雨靴；与库内 suite-xiexue-ertongmoticatiqiyundongxie（儿童魔术贴运动鞋）同属童鞋但产品型态不同（雨靴 vs 运动鞋），id/leaf 已区分。已剥离：IP 卡通角色印花（源品为蜘蛛侠元素，含鞋身图案与鞋底蜘蛛图形）、页头促销文案与英文字幕、儿童模特面部（改背面/腰下取景）、蓝色限定款等来源专属标签；认证类声明改为仅呈现微距可见的材质纹理与做工细节，不虚构资质。新版按规范将预留文案空白并入完整构图，信息图版式（环形卖点图、尺码表、四季拼版）的占比按版式可读性微调并已在对应镜注明。
